content.text:
Here are 30 companies as a JSON list. I wrote it from memory and didn't open the links, so check any link before you rely on it. Several sources are open-source repositories rather than blog posts, and these show Rust use but aren't formal "we use Rust in production" statements.

```json
[
  {"company": "Cloudflare", "use": "Pingora, the HTTP proxy that handles much of Cloudflare's traffic", "source": "https://blog.cloudflare.com/how-we-built-pingora-the-proxy-that-connects-cloudflare-to-the-internet/"},
  {"company": "Discord", "use": "Read States service, rewritten from Go for lower latency", "source": "https://discord.com/blog/why-discord-is-switching-from-go-to-rust"},
  {"company": "Dropbox", "use": "File sync engine (Nucleus)", "source": "https://dropbox.tech/infrastructure/rewriting-the-heart-of-our-sync-engine"},
  {"company": "Amazon Web Services", "use": "Firecracker microVMs, plus other infrastructure such as S3 and EC2 components", "source": "https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/why-aws-loves-rust-and-how-wed-like-to-help/"},
  {"company": "Microsoft", "use": "Safe systems programming, including Windows components and Azure", "source": "https://msrc.microsoft.com/blog/2019/07/why-rust-for-safe-systems-programming/"},
  {"company": "Google", "use": "Android platform components (Bluetooth, keystore, networking)", "source": "https://security.googleblog.com/2021/04/rust-in-android-platform.html"},
  {"company": "Meta", "use": "Source control backend (Mononoke, Sapling) and other internal tooling", "source": "https://engineering.fb.com/2021/04/29/developer-tools/rust/"},
  {"company": "Mozilla", "use": "Stylo CSS engine in Firefox", "source": "https://hacks.mozilla.org/2017/08/inside-a-super-fast-css-engine-quantum-css-aka-stylo/"},
  {"company": "Figma", "use": "Multiplayer sync server", "source": "https://www.figma.com/blog/rust-in-production-at-figma/"},
  {"company": "npm, Inc.", "use": "Authorization service in the registry", "source": "https://www.rust-lang.org/static/pdfs/Rust-npm-Whitepaper.pdf"},
  {"company": "Fastly", "use": "Lucet WebAssembly compiler and runtime for Compute@Edge", "source": "https://www.fastly.com/blog/announcing-lucet-fastly-native-webassembly-compiler-runtime"},
  {"company": "Shopify", "use": "YJIT, the Ruby JIT compiler", "source": "https://shopify.engineering/ruby-yjit-is-ready"},
  {"company": "Buoyant (Linkerd)", "use": "linkerd2-proxy service mesh data plane", "source": "https://linkerd.io/2020/07/23/under-the-hood-of-linkerds-state-of-the-art-rust-proxy-linkerd2-proxy/"},
  {"company": "Deno Land", "use": "The Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime", "source": "https://deno.com/blog/v1"},
  {"company": "Vercel", "use": "Turbopack bundler", "source": "https://vercel.com/blog/turbopack"},
  {"company": "Astral", "use": "uv and Ruff Python tooling", "source": "https://astral.sh/blog/uv"},
  {"company": "Canonical", "use": "sudo-rs and uutils coreutils in Ubuntu", "source": "https://discourse.ubuntu.com/t/adopting-sudo-rs-by-default-in-ubuntu-25-10/60583"},
  {"company": "Materialize", "use": "Streaming SQL database", "source": "https://github.com/MaterializeInc/materialize"},
  {"company": "InfluxData", "use": "InfluxDB IOx / InfluxDB 3 time-series engine", "source": "https://www.influxdata.com/blog/announcing-influxdb-iox/"},
  {"company": "PingCAP", "use": "TiKV distributed key-value store", "source": "https://github.com/tikv/tikv"},
  {"company": "Oxide Computer", "use": "Hubris embedded OS and rack firmware", "source": "https://oxide.computer/blog/hubris-and-humility"},
  {"company": "Mullvad VPN", "use": "VPN client app daemon", "source": "https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app"},
  {"company": "Signal", "use": "libsignal cryptographic protocol library", "source": "https://github.com/signalapp/libsignal"},
  {"company": "Zed Industries", "use": "Zed code editor", "source": "https://zed.dev/blog/zed-is-now-open-source"},
  {"company": "Embark Studios", "use": "Game development tooling and services", "source": "https://embark.dev"},
  {"company": "Svix", "use": "Webhook sending service", "source": "https://github.com/svix/svix-webhooks"},
  {"company": "Parity Technologies", "use": "Polkadot/Substrate blockchain framework", "source": "https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-sdk"},
  {"company": "Solana Labs", "use": "Solana blockchain validator", "source": "https://github.com/solana-labs/solana"},
  {"company": "Sentry", "use": "Relay event ingestion service", "source": "https://github.com/getsentry/relay"},
  {"company": "Brave Software", "use": "Ad-blocking engine in the Brave browser", "source": "https://github.com/brave/adblock-rust"}
]
```

I can open the links and fix or replace any that fail.
